title: A Cipher for the Witness Anew
author: Petra Okafor
blurb: Kestrel Whitlock, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
